subject: English
question_text: According to the passage, give some ideas of the function of money.
guide_solution: Money is very important in life. Money can ensure our happiness for a little while. But it cannot give us absolute happiness. Though money provides us with some earthly materials but these are not all.
source: SSC English 1st Paper Test Paper 116 — Charakgachia Secondary School, Barguna

question_text: What suffering does a rich man undergo?
guide_solution: The richest men of our society are not the happiest man. They lead a life burdened with cares and anxieties and pass sleepless night.

subject: English
question_text: Describe the condition of the rich and the poor.
guide_solution: The rich men lead a life burdened with cares and anxieties and pass sleepless night. On the other hand, there is a large number of poor men who are happy and enjoy a sound sleep as they are content with what they have.

subject: English
question_text: Why can money not ensure happiness?
guide_solution: Money cannot ensure happiness because it is absolutely a psychological matter. Happiness means the contentment of the mind. Happiness lies only in contentment.
source: SSC English 1st Paper Test Paper 116 — Charakgachia Secondary School, Barguna
